purpose: Find naturally occurring residual decision gaps against the fixed cheap family on unused service dates; admission to investigation, not a G2 or independent-calibration success by itself.
sources: Existing local and configured server archives. Inventory filenames, archive members and capture clocks before reading target endpoints or forecast values. No raw CSV/checkpoint transfer; filter on server and retrieve only small receipts.

date_selection.order: Chronological first unused service dates with existing matching static service data, actual endpoint archive and RT capture coverage for the original public time window. This continues the prior14-date rule. Exclude every date used for fitting, model selection, calibration, outcome inspection or control replay. Metadata-only inspection does not expose outcomes.
date_selection.capture_coverage: Check capture filename clocks before freezing dates; archive name alone is insufficient. If content or event coverage is missing after freezing, retain missing cases and do not replace dates.
date_selection.incomplete_panel: Keep all considered dates with their exclusion or missing-source reasons. Fewer than14 dates is an incomplete panel; no independent population acceptance. No used date substitutes and no old72-root replay.

fixed.physical_model: V34 model_fit and V41 PhysicalHistory; no target-date refit or likelihood tuning
fixed.public_root_rule: Reuse decision_calibration_v2.select_public / V34 public structural recipe before actual labels; retain initially missing or canceled roots. Same stations, scheduled window, 12 roots per date, public order, horizon and MCT.
fixed.menu: V50 wide_root then decision_gap_v1.expand_menu public prefix closure; preserve pickup/dropoff, remaining ride depth, absorption and observation rules. Do not choose roots or candidates by gains, actual endpoints or predicted action advantage.
fixed.information: Correct source-version native trip identities before RT decoding. All policies share the external received stream and the expanded observation contract; endogenous histories follow actions. No future remote messages in planning worlds.
fixed.execution: One cold rotated measured run per policy and registered root; no selected reruns or increased sample budgets. Keep ideal action clocks as in the frozen executor; record fully charged CPU separately.

events: Register the first public onboard decision, every upstream menu candidate and each declared downstream legal exit before reading labels. Keep no-downstream-opportunity cases, missing histories, initial endpoint failure, cancellation, forecast-only or ambiguous endpoints. Actual endpoint coverage must cover the expanded menu and local observation connections.

comparison.gain: Baseline loss minus challenger loss; positive means improvement. Compare every fixed policy separately, do not deploy a per-root hindsight-best baseline.
comparison.unknown: Preserve loss=None and the original [0,deadline-start] bound; paired gain uses interval subtraction. Do not infer absence of messages from a missing archive. Report complete-pair means only as supplementary.
comparison.candidate_gap: A predeclared feasible challenger has strictly positive observed gain against every one of the six fixed cheap policies at a complete registered root. Report all positive, negative, tie and unknown roots and duplicate event clusters. This is an observed candidate mechanism, not proof of an expected-value gap.
comparison.panel_value: Report all-root and per-date paired quality and billed CPU, retaining unknown bounds. A single favorable event does not establish overall superiority.
comparison.operational_admission: For a claim about actual catchability retain source identity, predecision message timing and concrete platform-transfer provenance. Missing actual platform evidence remains unresolved; station-MCT replay is a model-relative diagnosis.
comparison.deeper_reconstruction: Requires a residual mechanism not explained by existing cheap policies or input/menu defects and a separate structural/theoretical novelty argument. No residual signal, insufficient data or unresolved operating evidence does not authorize deeper reconstruction.
comparison.calibration: Any probability confirmation retains decision_calibration_v1/acceptance_rules.json:14 dates, original4 partitions, +/-0.02 bias band and original20000 day bootstrap. This stage does not relax or replace that gate.

retention: All considered dates, registered roots, events, positive/negative/tie/missing outcomes and computational unknowns remain in denominator. Data availability is not a negative scientific outcome.
